source.label: Denoised source
source.description: Name of the virtual PipeWire source created by the bundled filter-chain config.

poll_interval.label: Refresh interval (ms)
poll_interval.description: How often the tile and widget re-read the current state.

hardware_source.label: Microphone
hardware_source.description: Source name of the physical microphone; leave empty for automatic (last used input, then the first available one). To see the names, run "pactl list short sources" in a terminal - the microphone is an alsa_input.* entry.

auto_reload.label: Reload PipeWire automatically
auto_reload.description: Restart PipeWire once after the filter-chain config is written, so denoising works without a manual restart. Turn off if you would rather pick the moment (e.g. during a call).

config-installed.title: Mic Denoise ready
config-installed.body: PipeWire filter-chain config installed. Restart PipeWire once, then toggle denoising on.
config-installed.reloaded: PipeWire was restarted to load it - switching denoising on works now.

failed.title: Mic Denoise failed
failed.body: The audio backend reported no details.

timeout.body: pactl did not answer in time; is PipeWire running?

spawn-failed.body: Could not run the bundled backend script.

mic-changed.title: Microphone changed
mic-changed.body: The filter-chain now captures from the new microphone.
mic-changed.body-restarted: PipeWire was restarted so the filter-chain loads the new capture target.

ladspa.title: Mic Denoise needs noise-suppression-for-voice
ladspa.body: The RNNoise LADSPA plugin is missing, so the denoised source cannot exist. Install it - typical command: {cmd} - then restart PipeWire and enable denoising again.

not-ready.title: Mic Denoise is not ready
not-ready.body: The denoised source is missing. Restart PipeWire to load the filter-chain: systemctl --user restart pipewire pipewire-pulse wireplumber
